title: Stop mourning what you lost and start preparing for what’s coming. 🔥
paragraphs: Stop mourning what you lost and start preparing for what’s coming. 🔥

This is the hardest part of faith: The empty space between the "removal" and the "replacement." It feels like loss. It feels like a battlefield. But look at the warrior in the image—he isn't looking down at the dust; he's looking UP at the promise.

God isn't punishing you by taking that relationship, that job, or that comfort zone away. He is literally clearing space because the blessing you actually prayed for is too big to fit into your old life. Your hands have to be empty to receive what He's about to drop.
Don't give up in the middle of the transition. The upgrade is imminent.

⚔️ The Anchor Verse: "Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland." — Isaiah 43:18-19 (NIV)
👇 Are you in the removal phase or the replacement phase right now?
